items.title: Android Malware Mutes Alerts, Drains Crypto Wallets
items.description: Android/BankBot-YNRK is currently targeting users in Indonesia by masquerading as legitimate applications.

items.title: Hacker steals over $120 million from Balancer DeFi crypto protocol

items.title: Hackers Weaponize Remote Tools to Hijack Cargo Freight
items.description: Researchers uncovered a new threat campaign in which attackers use RMM tools to steal physical cargo out of the supply chain.
